questions.question: after_tool_call exists on the pinned OpenClaw SDK/runtime
questions.evidence_ref: PLUGIN_HOOK_NAMES includes after_tool_call; hook-types d.ts declares (event: PluginHookAfterToolCallEvent, ctx: PluginHookToolContext) => Promise<void> | void; harness registers and drives the real runner; live turns fired it on the real observer

questions.question: actual TypeScript type/fields of the handler input
questions.evidence_ref: PluginHookAfterToolCallEvent = { toolName: string; params: Record<string, unknown>; runId?: string; toolCallId?: string; result?: unknown; error?: string; durationMs?: number }; PluginHookToolContext = { agentId?; sessionKey?; sessionId?; runId?; trace?; toolName; toolKind?; toolInputKind?; toolCallId?; getSessionExtension?; channelId? }; harness confirms verbatim pass-through

questions.question: event.toolCallId / ctx.toolCallId are provided stably
questions.evidence_ref: live: host-generated call ids present and identical on event and ctx in all three scenarios (allow/error/deny); both tool execution entry points propagate toolCallId

questions.question: toolCallId identical between before_tool_call and after_tool_call
questions.evidence_ref: live: the same call id observed in before_tool_call, real execute, and after_tool_call for every scenario; emit path derives after toolCallId from the harness item.id

questions.question: result shape on the success path
questions.evidence_ref: live S-allow: success result passed through as an object with numeric durationMs and no error. Caveat (deterministic, proven): the emit helper includes result via a truthiness check, so falsy successful results (false/0/empty-string/null) omit BOTH result and error; field presence must never classify success/failure

questions.question: error/throw path still triggers after_tool_call
questions.evidence_ref: live S-error: the real host observer emitted after_tool_call for the throwing tool; error is a bounded string; the host also populates result with the error-shaped tool result, so error and result coexist on failure

questions.question: error field and duration field semantics
questions.evidence_ref: live: error is a bounded string when present; durationMs numeric on success and failure observations; blocked observations carry the blocked result in error shape

questions.question: before_tool_call handler completion happens-before tool invocation
questions.evidence_ref: wrapToolWithBeforeToolCallHook awaits runBeforeToolCallHook before calling the real execute (real wrapper code); live sequences confirm before_tool_call precedes tool_executed

questions.question: blocked (block:true) calls still trigger after_tool_call
questions.evidence_ref: live S-deny: block:true produced ZERO executions (no tool_executed record) yet the real host observer emitted after_tool_call carrying the blocked result in error shape (resultPresent=true, errorPresent=true). Consequence for PR-RTE-03: after-hook arrival is NOT proof of invocation; blocked gate states must never produce terminal execution facts (contract 03 §5.2)

questions.question: ordering of after_tool_call relative to tool_result_persist
questions.evidence_ref: live (all scenarios): before_tool_call -> after_tool_call -> tool_result_persist. CORRECTS the rev2 static hypothesis (persist-first): for plugin tools the deferred after observation lands before transcript persistence; PR-RTE-03 must not assume persist has completed when the after hook arrives

questions.question: runtime behavior when an after_tool_call handler throws
questions.evidence_ref: runVoidHook catches per-handler errors under the fail-open policy (logs, does not rethrow) and sibling handlers still run; the hook-helpers wrapper additionally try/catches with a warn log; harness test proves containment with no mutation of tool facts

questions.question: with multiple plugins, are params/result seen by AgentGuard original, pre-rewrite, or final values
questions.evidence_ref: before-chain handlers see ORIGINAL params; the real execute receives adjusted params (recordAdjustedParamsForToolCall); with matching runId the after event carries adjusted params through the real consumeAdjustedParamsForToolCall channel. Still partial: the multi-plugin rewrite scenario was not re-run live, and a missing/mismatched runId silently degrades the after params to startArgs

questions.question: can other plugins still rewrite params after approval and before execution
questions.evidence_ref: param rewrites happen only inside the single awaited before_tool_call chain that also carries requireApproval; there is no second rewrite phase between approval release and execute in the pinned host path. Live approval-lifecycle timing was not exercised

questions.question: toolCallId reuse across retries
questions.evidence_ref: /tools/invoke derives toolCallId from the caller idempotencyKey (same key -> same id; no key -> fresh timestamp id); the agent loop assigns per-item ids, so an LLM-level retry is a new item with a new id. A live retry scenario was not exercised

c2_gate_criteria.evidence_ref: Q03/Q04: identical host-supplied toolCallId observed live across before/execute/after in allow, error, and deny scenarios, and under param rewrite in the harness
Q08: the real wrapper awaits the full before chain before the real execute; live sequences confirm happens-before

all terminal shapes are now deterministic and documented: success -> result passthrough + numeric durationMs; failure -> bounded string error PLUS error-shaped result; blocked -> zero invocation with blocked result in error shape; falsy success -> both fields omitted. The terminal classifier rule (never infer success/failure from field presence) is fixed

Q09 live: zero invocation confirmed and after-hook emission on blocked calls observed on the real host; the implementation rule (blocked gate states never produce terminal execution facts, after arrival treated as observation-only) is implementable and covered by the live deny scenario

c2_gate_criteria.criterion: multi-plugin rewrites do not break security-critical identity
c2_gate_criteria.evidence_ref: Q12 (runId fixed): toolCallId identity is host-supplied and untouched by param merges; adjusted params flow through the real record/consume channel; identity stayed stable under rewrite; live scenarios confirm host-supplied identity on the real observer path
